title: Reduced zero-dimensional fibres of filtered etale colimits
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I$ a small filtered category, $D:I\to\mathrm{CAlg}_A$ a diagram of commutative $A$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and $B=\operatorname{colim}D$. Suppose each $D_i$ is etale over $A$ [def-weil-etale-morphism]. For any prime $p$ of $A$, the fibre $C=\kappa(p)\otimes_A B$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is reduced (every nilpotent is zero) and every prime ideal of $C$ is maximal (equivalently, its Krull dimension is at most zero). No Noetherian hypothesis is required.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0AH1, proof; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0AH1

proof.text: Write C_i=κ(p)⊗_A D_i. Tensor symmetry and the elementwise tensor-colimit statement show every element of C lifts to a C_i, and an element of C_i vanishing in C becomes zero under some transition map.

Etale base change makes C_i etale over κ(p). Mathlib Algebra.FormallyUnramified.finite_of_free and isReduced_of_field give finite-dimensionality and reducedness; IsArtinianRing.of_finite gives Artinianity. In particular every prime of C_i is maximal. These are consequences of the etale-over-field product structure.
For x nilpotent in C lift x=γ_i(y). If x^n=0, lift this vanishing to a transition u:i→j; τ_u(y)^n=0, so τ_u(y)=0. The colimit cocone identity γ_j∘τ_u=γ_i gives x=0.

If Q≤M are prime ideals in C, their contractions to C_i are comparable prime ideals. Since the smaller contraction is maximal, they coincide. Lift each x∈M to a stage to conclude x∈Q, so Q=M. Apply this with M a maximal ideal containing Q, whose existence follows from Q≠top. Thus every prime is maximal, i.e. Ring.KrullDimLE 0 C.
